job.title: Information Systems Security Engineer
job.pay_full: $100,000 – $174,000 a year estimated salary; total compensation may also include restricted stock units, a sign-on bonus and other incentives

details.about: Palantir builds software for data-driven decisions and operations. This team combines cybersecurity and US Government policy expertise to deploy Palantir's software for government customers quickly while keeping the government's trust: it automates security management for Palantir's US Government facilities, works closely with stakeholders and owns the Authorization to Operate (ATO) process.
duties: Bridge engineering and compliance to meet both technical and regulatory requirements
Work with ISSMs, engineers, FSOs and business stakeholders to deliver consistent solutions across facilities
Apply STIGs/SRGs to operating systems and applications to meet DoD standards, and explain the security and compliance posture of on-premise facilities and cloud infrastructure to auditors
Turn regulations such as NIST 800-53 and CNSSI 1253 into actionable technical requirements
Produce clear evidence such as System Security Plans (SSPs) and architecture diagrams
Connect technical operations, executive leadership and government partners, and give leaders insight into technical and compliance risk
needs: Active US DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance, and willingness to upgrade and maintain a higher level of access
Proven cybersecurity experience in a US Government context
Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed (25% travel preferred; varies by location)
nice: Skill at interpreting and explaining government policy to varied audiences
A technical background in engineering or system administration
Information security fundamentals: authentication, encryption, networking, vulnerability scanning, audit logs
Customer-service mindset, strong time management and attention to detail
details.benefits: Estimated salary $100,000 – $174,000 a year; total compensation may also include restricted stock units, a sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Benefits include medical, dental and vision insurance, basic life, AD&D and disability cover, commuter benefits, relocation assistance, take-what-you-need paid time off plus two weeks off at the end of each year (subject to team and business needs), 10 paid holidays, paid parental leave and subsidized back-up care, fertility and family-building benefits, a new-child stipend and a 401(k) plan.
notes: Requires an active US DoD Secret or Top Secret clearance
Palantir encourages working from its offices; many teams offer hybrid options
Palantir never asks candidates for payment or financial information during interviews
